plans.name: Moderato
plans.note: Agent credit values are approximate values based on typical task token consumption and are for reference only. Monthly credits are converted to the equivalent number of tasks for the same feature. Membership features share a single credit pool metered by token usage. Kimi Code has separate 5-hour and weekly rate limits, but the page does not state their numeric amounts.
